DESCRIPTION_KR: UV-02 is a portable air sterilizer that is designed with a lightweight, built-in handle, and lithium battery. It can operate for up to 35 hours without requiring additional power supply. Even if the built-in battery is drained, it can be immediately used with a USB power supply.; The sterilizer adopts a "triple filtration system" that includes UV-C light, negative ions, and a HEPA 13-grade filter. This system provides "comprehensive protection" by offering disinfection, sterilization, and antibacterial features. It can effectively remove fine pollutants, such as those with PM2.5 values, as well as smoke and chemical odors in both car and indoor spaces.; The HEPA filter has a purification efficiency of up to 99.97% and filters suspended particles that have a diameter larger than 0.3 micrometers. It effectively filters exhaust gas, fine dust, smoke, pollen, odors, pet hair, bacteria, and viruses.; Moreover, it can alleviate symptoms of hay fever, nasal sensitivity, and bronchial sensitivity. In low wind mode, the wind noise is as low as 48 dB, which means it won't disturb your sleep.

DESCRIPTION_KR: LAPEL PINS have a long history in human society. In addition to being used to indicate identity, lapel pins nowadays have become a popular accessory. Commonly used techniques for making custom metal pins include soft enamel, imitation hard enamel, stamping, photo etching, 3D effect, screen printing, and offset printing… etc.; SOFT ENAMEL is the most common way for custom metal pins. The recessed part of the badge can be filled in colors, and the raised part of the badge can be used for various electroplating effects. The surface can be coated with a layer of transparent protective resin (Epoxy). This process is commonly known as “dome” (note that because of light refraction, the surface of the badge will be bright after the epoxy is applied), but the soft enamel badge after adding epoxy the unevenness is lost, but it can protect the logo.  The color for soft enamel is bright, the lines are clear and lively, and the metal material has a strong texture. You can use brass or iron as the raw material. The iron stamped soft enamel badge is cheap and good. If you have a small budget, you can’t miss it!

NAME_KR: Popular large capacity laptop backpack for travelling school business outdoor
NAME_EN: Popular large capacity laptop backpack for travelling school business outdoor
DESCRIPTION_KR: Laptop backpack; A laptop backpack is a type of bag specifically designed to carry and protect laptops and other electronic devices. It is a convenient and practical solution for people who frequently travel or commute with their laptops. Laptop backpacks typically have a dedicated padded compartment or sleeve that provides extra protection and cushioning for the laptop.; When choosing a laptop backpack, there are a few factors to consider:; Size and Compatibility: Ensure that the backpack is suitable for your laptop's size. Most laptop backpacks come in various sizes, accommodating laptops ranging from 13 inches to 17 inches.; Padding and Protection: Look for a backpack that offers sufficient padding and protection for your laptop. Check if it has a well-padded laptop compartment or sleeve to prevent damage from bumps and impacts.; Comfort and Ergonomics: Consider the backpack's comfort features, such as padded shoulder straps and a breathable back panel. Adjustable straps and a sternum strap can help distribute the weight evenly and reduce strain on your shoulders and back.; Organization and Storage: Evaluate the backpack's organizational features and storage capacity. Look for compartments and pockets to keep your laptop accessories, cables, and other belongings organized and easily accessible.; Durability and Quality: Ensure that the backpack is made from durable materials that can withstand daily use and protect your laptop effectively. Water-resistant or waterproof materials can be beneficial to protect your laptop from moisture.; Style and Design: Choose a backpack that suits your personal style and preferences. Laptop backpacks come in various designs, colors, and styles, allowing you to find one that matches your taste.
